description: Demolition of existing buildings. Redevelopment of site to create 17 Dwellings (C3) and 142 flats with associated landscaping and car parking. (Summary)
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than the  expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
site_name: Development At 1 To 3 Boundary Close And Former Hyleford School Site
